items.headline: Meta advances clean firm procurement framework across multiple nuclear developers
items.what_happened: Meta expanded its advanced clean electricity portfolio by detailing framework agreements for up to 6.6 GW of nuclear generation through the 2030s, pairing operating plant capacity with exploratory advance offtake mechanisms for advanced reactor developers including Oklo and TerraPower.
items.why_it_matters: Following Google's Kairos master agreement, Meta's multi-technology approach shows hyperscalers are creating structured off-balance-sheet demand signals to justify vendor supply-chain buildouts.
items.binding_note: Framework agreements and exploratory clean firm commitments; definitive per-site PPAs remain subject to licensing and project development milestones.
